description: Curated semantic mappings from GeoStrata lithologies to Conquest Reforged material families. This file is outside the core jar and is intended for optional pack/data integrations only.

roles.geology: Solid Conquest material variants suitable for representing the lithology itself when a Conquest-aware integration is active.
roles.weathered: Solid surface/weathering variants suitable near exposed contacts.
roles.rubble: Loose rock/debris variants suitable for scree, talus or eroded exposures.
roles.construction: Processed architectural material families suitable for geology-aware structures/building palettes, not natural rock replacement.

lithologies.reason: Conquest contains a direct limestone family plus natural colour/weathering and loose-rock variants.
